rv.q: When LuPone is off stage, though, the show sags. Kevin Anderson, who plays the opportunistic Joe, is too likable in the role. The musical is a triumph for LuPone and a reaffirmation of Lloyd Webber's gift for song.
Sunset Boulevard es el hit que todo el mundo quiere ver.

Close is the major reason to see Trevor Nunn's production of Andrew Lloyd Webber's latest, an extravaganza that turns Billy Wilder's acidic movie classic about the Hollywood dream-machine into a sort of theme-park operetta noir.
Sunset Boulevard, however, is little more than an expensive explosion of kitsch, the denigration of a movie classic.
